title: Host slot record (F154-FR-039 to F154-FR-042, F154-FR-044; data-model.md D8)
description: One holder of one host bound: full executions of a check set (`host.checks.concurrent`), live sessions of one harness account (`host.sessions.<account>`, F154-FR-040), or an exclusive resource declared with a capacity (F154-FR-042). PROPOSAL of spec 154. A slot is a directory lock under `<user-state>/slots/<bound>/` in user-level state (F100 annex B row proposed), made by the lock of feature 122 with the lock's owner record and lease. It is written by its holder's runtime root only, atomically; a record whose owner is proven dead is reclaimed by a contending runtime root through the lock's liveness proof, one whose owner lives is never removed, and one whose liveness is unknown counts as held (F154-FR-044). Admission is decided by `slot-admission-table.json` (SL-1…SL-5) over the lock's probe outcomes. No model takes or releases a slot (F154-FR-005). Written only with `host.limits` on; a parity-register row names the record.

bound.description: The host bound the slot belongs to: a check-set bound, a session bound of one account, or an exclusive resource.

width.description: The capacity of the bound: N lock directories exist under it.

index.description: The position of this slot under its bound, 0 to width - 1; `acquire` tries them in order.

owner.description: The owner record of the lock (`ownerRecordFor`): who holds the slot.

pid.description: The process id of the holder's runtime root.

processGroup.description: The process group of the holder.

startTime.description: When the holder's process started; compared with the boot id, as the lock does, when a clock jumps.

bootId.description: The boot id of the host at the start of the holder.

hostName.description: The host the slot is held on. A slot held on another host is `held-foreign` and counts as held.

pidNamespace.description: The pid namespace of the holder, where the host has one.

launchId.description: The launch the holder's run belongs to.

runTokenHash.description: The hash of the holder's run token.

livenessEndpoint.description: The endpoint a contender probes for the liveness proof of the lock (`stale-owner-dead`, `held-live`, `unknown`).

runId.description: The run that holds the slot.

schema.description: The schema id of the lock's lease record, as feature 122 writes it.

lockProvider.description: The lock provider that made the directory lock.

validUntil.description: Compared with the boot id and start time, as the lock does.
